sealed_statement.abstract_forcing: Any seven distinct vertices in role order B1-C1-B2-C2-X0-C3-B3 with all six consecutive edges and all fifteen nonconsecutive pairs absent induce P7. Hence a P7-free realization must contain at least one of the fifteen chords.
sealed_statement.exact_consequence: For the frozen inverse-Golovach T0 annotation, every P7-killing chord either violates source axiom (iv) or changes at least one tracked object among G[U], D_C, A(u), B_C/mu_C/MIN_BAD, or the residual-component partition.
sealed_statement.repair_firewall: Changing a tracked object is not itself an exact repair. Any use of such a chord requires a separate semantics-preservation and reconstruction theorem.

generalization_limit.reason: Endpoint role type alone is insufficient: same-color X0 identity redundancy can make B-X0 or C-X0 edge insertion color-mask neutral in other source states. General C5B requires color-annotated source-derived grammar completeness.
